revenueRecognition.principle: Revenue is recognised when goods are delivered and installation is complete — not at order confirmation or deposit receipt
revenueRecognition.practicalApplication: For milestone payment projects, recognise revenue proportionally as milestones are achieved and confirmed in writing
revenueRecognition.deferredRevenue: Deposits received before delivery are deferred revenue on the balance sheet — they are a liability until the goods are delivered

keyMetrics.grossRevenue: Total invoice value including GST and delivery/installation charges
keyMetrics.grossProfit: Net revenue minus Cost of Goods Sold (product cost, freight, customs, installation labour)
keyMetrics.grossMargin: Gross Profit / Net Revenue × 100 — target 32–40% blended
keyMetrics.netProfit: Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses (admin, sales, rent, marketing, depreciation)
keyMetrics.EBITDA: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, amortisation — useful for benchmarking operational performance

criticalFinancialRatios.currentRatio: Current Assets / Current Liabilities — target >1.5 for healthy liquidity
criticalFinancialRatios.quickRatio: Liquid Assets / Current Liabilities — target >1.0; indicates ability to meet short-term obligations without selling inventory
criticalFinancialRatios.debtorsDays: Accounts Receivable / (Net Revenue / 365) — target <45 days; watch carefully during project ramp-up
criticalFinancialRatios.creditorsDays: Accounts Payable / (COGS / 365) — align with supplier payment terms; don't pay early unless there is a discount

minimum: Cash Position (bank balance + receivables due within 30 days - payables due within 30 days)
Pipeline summary by stage and value
monthlyManagementAccounts.frequency: Monthly by the 15th of the following month
monthlyManagementAccounts.reviewer: CEO and external accountant quarterly minimum
monthlyManagementAccounts.warning: A business without monthly management accounts cannot make confident pricing, hiring, or investment decisions — this is non-negotiable at TCD's revenue level
